svg.title: NET-10-U — Failed session refresh
svg.desc: Actual failed refresh after populated selected results. Unchanged geometry. The retained five-column heading strip sits above an empty white body with one complete noninteractive error line. Cached rows and selected identity, endpoint, and mode details are hidden. Refresh is focused, every browser join disabled. This black-and-white structural diagram uses production colors specified by UX-NET-10-011.

g.text: Directory unavailable. Direct connection and local play are still available.
Refresh successfully before joining. Availability unconfirmed.
LAN-first. A listing does not guarantee reachability.
Retained five-column heading strip; empty white body with one full noninteractive error line.
Cached rows and selected identity/endpoint/mode hidden. Refresh focused.
Recovery restores retained identity only if present, never another session.
Status and paging allocations stay reserved; conditional paging group unchanged.
